senses.gloss: m. (רעה = רוה, v. רֵיאָה a. רֳאִי II; cmp. דִּבְיוֹנִים) secretion, excrements.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 7b:18">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>דרך הר׳</he> (Rashi <he>דרך בית הר׳</he>) in the secretory channel (instead of in the womb).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:2">Kel. XVII, 2</cite> <he>בית הר׳ … מקבל את הר׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>הראי</he>) a night chamber which is too defective to retain liquid matter, although it retains solid excrements.
Cant. R. to III, 4 בית הר׳ privy.
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:16">Tosef. Ber. II, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 25b:16">Ber. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>גרף של ר׳</he> a vessel for excrements; <cite ref="Shabbat 47a:4">Sabb. 47ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
